profile.name: Carles Arnal
profile.headline: Making distributed systems work together.
profile.intro: I build open-source infrastructure for the contracts between services, data and AI. Principal Software Engineer at IBM, Apicurio Registry core maintainer and Quarkus committer.
profile.bio: My work sits where applications meet infrastructure: how services exchange data, how contracts evolve, and how teams can change a system without losing confidence in it. I work on Apicurio Registry, contribute to the Java and cloud-native ecosystem, and turn implementation lessons into talks and practical examples.
profile.teaching: Alongside engineering, I teach at BarcelonaTech (UPC). I enjoy making difficult systems understandable through small examples, clear diagrams and code people can run themselves.

experience.description: Technical ownership of Apicurio Registry's distributed architecture following the transition from Red Hat. Working across product direction, reliability, security and the continuity of the open-source project.
Core engineering on Apicurio Registry: Kafka and Pulsar integrations, a multi-tenant managed service, identity-provider integration, Kubernetes deployment and CI/CD automation.
experience.progression: Software Engineer, April 2020 · Senior, July 2022 · Principal, April 2024

experience.description: Modernized a Java monolith into Spring Boot services on AWS. Built APIs for web and mobile applications and introduced Redis caching.
Led a team while building Spring backends and delivering mobile and web applications from architecture through integration.
Built REST and SOAP services for digital banking with Spring and JBoss. Worked with OSGi, COBOL/MQ integration and Java monitoring tools for financial systems.
Designed and delivered mobile and web applications, building a foundation in end-to-end software development.

teaching_roles.description: Teaching software engineering and mentoring students in distributed systems and object-oriented programming.
Teaching web development and supervising master's theses.

patents: Message schema migration in messaging systems
Managing a presentation mode for application programming interface functions
recognition: Red Hat Patent Program Inventor — Level 1
